accounts.title: Mail accounts
accounts.displayNameHint: Optional: how Mailroom names this account to you. Without one, it uses the login.

autoconfig.hint: Find settings asks the domain itself, its DNS and Thunderbird's provider database, sending them only the domain.

sources.srv: Settings from the domain's DNS records ({{origin}}).
sources.mx: Settings of {{provider}}, where the domain's mail goes ({{origin}}).

autoconfig.appPassword: {{provider}} wants an app password, created in your {{provider}} account's security settings, not your usual password.
autoconfig.check: Check them before adding the account.
autoconfig.outsideDomain_one: These settings send your password to a server outside {{domain}}: {{hosts}}. Use them only if you know your mail is hosted there.
autoconfig.outsideDomain_other: These settings send your password to servers outside {{domain}}: {{hosts}}. Use them only if you know your mail is hosted there.
autoconfig.declined: Settings not used. Pick your provider or enter the settings yourself.
autoconfig.none: No settings found for {{domain}}. Pick your provider or enter the settings yourself.
autoconfig.unsupported: {{provider}} accounts are not supported yet: they need a sign-in Mailroom cannot do yet.
autoconfig.invalidAddress: Enter a whole email address, such as you@example.org.
autoconfig.busy: Too many lookups: try again in a minute.
autoconfig.failed: Could not look up the settings. Pick your provider or enter the settings yourself.

accounts.name: Your name
accounts.nameHint: Optional: shown to the people you write to.
accounts.defaultAddressHint: The address a new message is from, unless you choose another.
accounts.passwordHint: The mailbox password or app password. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
accounts.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
accounts.authservIdHint: Optional: the name your provider's mail servers put on their sender checks (the Authentication-Results header), such as mx.google.com for Gmail. Mailroom believes only those checks; without it, no sender is shown as verified.
accounts.sendModeHint: Limits what agents may do through MCP: Off refuses them, Drafts only leaves their mail as drafts, After approval sends only to approved recipients, Directly sends. Your own Send always works, unless this is Off.
accounts.actionFailed: That did not work. Try again.
accounts.noPassword: No stored password: edit the account to enter it.
accounts.confirmRemoval: Remove {{account}} and its filters? The mail on the server stays.
accounts.runFiltersOnHint: The worker runs this account's filters.
accounts.runFiltersOffHint: Off: nothing runs on this account until you turn it on.

quota.unknown: Usage unknown: the mail server does not report it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.intro: Mailroom writes your dates in this time zone.
timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.saveFailed: Could not save the time zone.

markRead.title: Mark all as read
markRead.intro: On a folder with subfolders, what “Mark all as read” in its menu does first. The menu offers the other one too.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.intro: Each conversation is then one row in the message lists, with how many messages it has and who wrote them; what you do to the row is done to every message of it. Only lists read from the mail index are grouped.

remoteSenders.title: Remote images
remoteSenders.intro: Senders whose remote images you always show. A sender counts only when its message passed DMARC at the account's authentication server.
remoteSenders.none: No senders yet: choose “Always for this sender” beside a message's remote images.

mailIndex.title: Index
mailIndex.intro: Mailroom keeps the headers of your mail (senders, subjects, dates, flags and a short preview, never the text) for the folders checked below, so they list and search fast. A folder left unchecked is read from the server, as before.
mailIndex.maxAgeHint: Older messages are not indexed and stay readable from the server. Leave it empty for no limit.
mailIndex.loadFailed: Could not load this account's folders.
mailIndex.lastDays_one: Messages from the last day are indexed.
mailIndex.lastDays_other: Messages from the last {{count}} days are indexed.
mailIndex.cap_one: This server indexes at most a day.
mailIndex.cap_other: This server indexes at most {{count}} days.
mailIndex.gmail: On Gmail, All Mail is indexed and Inbox and the labels are read from it; Spam and Trash are always read from the server.
mailIndex.label: Read from All Mail
mailIndex.off: Not indexed: read from the server

desktopNotifications.title: Desktop notifications
desktopNotifications.intro: While a Mailroom tab is open, new mail in the folders checked below shows as a notification from your browser, with its sender and subject only; not for the folder the tab shows while you are on it.
desktopNotifications.denied: This browser blocks Mailroom's notifications: allow them in its settings for this site.
desktopNotifications.indexedOnly: Only folders on the index notify: switch one on under Index.
desktopNotifications.noFolders: No folder of this account is on the index.
desktopNotifications.loadFailed: Could not load this account's folders.

limits.title: Mail limits
limits.intro: They hold for your mail here and through connected apps, across all your accounts. Only you change them, here: a connected app cannot.
limits.send_per_hourHint: Sent messages in any hour, across your accounts.
limits.attachment_max_mbHint: All attachments together, at most {{max}} MB.
limits.body_chars: Characters of a message's text read at a time
limits.body_charsHint: Here and by connected apps; the rest follows in the next part. At least 500.
limits.move_max_mb: A message moved to another account (MB)
limits.move_max_mbHint: Each message, held whole while it is copied; at most {{max}} MB.

connect.title: Connect an app
connect.gone: This request is unknown, has expired or was already answered. Start connecting again from the app.
connect.selfRegistered: The app registered itself: its name is what it says it is, unchecked.
connect.access: Choose the tools it may use on your behalf. Those that send mail or delete it for good start unchecked; you can change your choice later on your profile.
connect.returnsTo: Approving or denying takes you back to
connect.revoke: You can disconnect it at any time from your profile.
connect.decideFailed: Could not record your answer. Try again.
connect.ssoRequired: To connect an app to this Mailroom, sign in through its identity provider, even if you are already signed in.

filters_read.label: Read filters
filters_read.description: Your accounts, their folders, rule sets, filters and runs.

filters_write.label: Edit filters
filters_write.description: Create and edit disabled rule sets and their filters.

filters_run.label: Run filters
filters_run.description: Dry runs, turning rule sets on, Run now and Run filters: acts on your mail.

mail_read.label: Read mail
mail_read.description: List, search and read your messages and their attachments.

mail_transfer.label: Move mail between accounts
mail_transfer.description: Move messages to another of your accounts; can delete the originals for good.

mail_folders.label: Manage folders
mail_folders.description: Create, rename and delete folders; a deleted folder's mail is gone for good.

mail_draft.label: Write drafts
mail_draft.description: Write and update drafts, without sending them.

mail_send.label: Send mail
mail_send.description: Send mail, as far as each account's Sending setting lets it.

audit_read.label: Read the activity
audit_read.description: The record of what was done to your mail.
